description: The crambin protein structure (PDB: 1CRN) is loaded in PyMOL. Your task is to produce a publication-quality ray-traced image of this protein and save it to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/crambin_raytrace.png. The image should meet these requirements: (1) use cartoon representation, (2) color the structure by secondary structure type so that helices, sheets, and loops are visually distinct, (3) render on a white background, and (4) ray-trace at 1920x1080 resolution for publication quality. The final saved PNG should clearly show crambin's mixed alpha/beta fold with smooth, anti-aliased surfaces and proper lighting.
